row.ascend_en: Useful for model selection and native attention-kernel support; under no-retraining constraints, review existing GQA/MLA models rather than changing the current architecture.
row.ascend_zh: 主要用于模型选型与原生架构算子支持评审；无重训约束下优先评审既有 GQA/MLA 模型服务路径，不建议直接改当前模型架构。
row.boundary_en: GQA explicitly generalizes MQA; MLA is a different architecture. Native-model deployment must be distinguished from converting a frozen checkpoint.
row.boundary_zh: GQA 对 MQA 的概括由论文明确支持；MLA 属于不同架构方案。部署原生模型与转换任意冻结模型必须分开。
row.name_en: Shared KV heads and latent caches
row.name_zh: 从 KV head 共享到潜变量缓存
row.question_en: Can an architecture reduce cache requirements at their source?
row.question_zh: 架构能否从源头减少每token的缓存需求？
row.summary_en: MQA shares one KV head; GQA offers an intermediate group count; MLA instead combines low-rank latent KV with decoupled RoPE.
row.summary_zh: MQA 共享单 KV head，GQA 提供组数可调的折中，MLA 则以低秩联合潜变量与解耦 RoPE 重构缓存表示。

row.ascend_en: Review low-bit cache and attention-kernel integration against format support, decode/projection cost and model quality; no local Ascend gain is established.
row.ascend_zh: 可评审低比特缓存与注意力核融合的价值；先看格式、反量化/投影成本、模型质量和 CANN/MindIE 支持，当前没有本地收益证据。
row.boundary_en: KIVI and QJL are a mechanism comparison, not proof of universal substitutability, composability or direct inheritance.
row.boundary_zh: KIVI 与 QJL 是机制路线比较，未证明对所有模型可替换、可叠加或存在直接继承。
row.question_en: How can cache bytes be reduced, and why do key/value representations differ?
row.question_zh: 缓存字节如何减少，K与V的表示为何不同？
row.summary_en: From distribution-aware asymmetric quantization to sketches for attention inner products: both reduce cache bytes while retaining token positions.
row.summary_zh: 从适应 K/V 分布的非对称量化，扩展到用 sketch 估计注意力内积；共同目标是降低缓存字节，而不是删除历史 token。

row.ascend_en: For long-context/RAG workloads, assess budget and retrieval coverage before paged-cache and head-kernel integration; exclude token-removal advice from projects that prohibit it.
row.ascend_zh: 面向长上下文/RAG 评审预算与检索覆盖率，再看分页缓存、head 分组与 kernel 接口；禁止删 token 的专项场景需排除相应建议。
row.boundary_en: Edges denote reviewed mechanism changes, not direct ancestry or universal superiority.
row.boundary_zh: 这里的箭头表示本页比较的机制变化，不代表三者直接继承或后一篇在所有条件下优于前一篇。
row.name_zh: KV 保留策略与选择粒度
row.question_en: Which historical information should be retained, and when is selection performed?
row.question_zh: 保留什么历史信息，在哪个阶段做选择？
row.summary_en: Compare dynamic token eviction, prefill-window token selection and head-specific full/streaming caches through signal, timing and retention granularity.
row.summary_zh: 从生成时动态 token 驱逐，到 prefill 观察窗口一次选择，再到按 head 分配完整/流式缓存；演变的关键是选择信号、执行时机和保留粒度。

row.ascend_en: Assess activation calibration, integer kernels and online-transform costs on Ascend, with a fixed model and runtime configuration.
row.ascend_zh: 昇腾评审应关注激活校准稳定性、整数矩阵核覆盖和在线变换开销；论文机制可借鉴，部署结论须匹配模型与运行配置。
row.boundary_en: Activation-guided AWQ or Wanda is not activation compression; this lineage includes methods that quantize activations.
row.boundary_zh: 激活统计用于指导 AWQ/Wanda 不等于激活压缩；该脉络仅纳入实际量化激活的方案。
row.name_en: Activation quantization: channel smoothing and invariant rotation
row.name_zh: 激活量化：通道平滑与计算等价旋转
row.question_en: How can activation outliers and joint low-precision computation be handled?
row.question_zh: 如何处理激活离群值并支持联合低精度计算？
row.summary_en: SmoothQuant shifts difficulty between activations and weights; QuaRot rotates and SpinQuant learns rotations. They address outliers through distinct approaches.
row.summary_zh: SmoothQuant 通过权重/激活之间迁移难度缓解离群值；QuaRot 采用计算等价旋转，SpinQuant 学习旋转。三者围绕离群值问题，后两者不是前者的简单版本升级。

row.ascend_en: Study deployment through matrix operations, while checking factored matrix shapes, scheduling and quality recovery. Fewer parameters do not guarantee speed.
row.ascend_zh: 可作为标准矩阵乘路线的部署研究，但减少参数不保证变快；评审两段矩阵乘的形状、调度与质量恢复成本。
row.boundary_en: Separate deployment factorization from LoRA adaptation. In ASVD, activations guide weight compression. SVD-LLM was rechecked at v5: full recovery includes LoRA fine-tuning of U/V factors, distinct from the whitening-only variant.
row.boundary_zh: 与 LoRA 的高效微调区分；ASVD 的激活感知是决策依据，主压缩对象是权重。 SVD-LLM已按v5复核：完整恢复过程包含U/V因子的LoRA微调；白化-only变体单列。
row.name_zh: 低秩权重：激活感知到截断损失感知
row.question_en: How can weight factorization retain input-dependent information?
row.question_zh: 如何让权重分解保留输入相关信息？
row.summary_en: ASVD accounts for activations and layer sensitivity. SVD-LLM addresses truncation-loss mismatch and missing parameter updates in earlier SVD methods.
row.summary_zh: ASVD 用激活分布和层敏感度改善分解；SVD-LLM 明确针对已有 SVD 方法的截断损失错配与缺少参数修正问题，提出白化和顺序低秩修正。

row.ascend_en: For workloads permitting a new deployed model, assess training budget and student reasoning quality before Ascend deployment costs.
row.ascend_zh: 适用于允许改变部署模型的业务，先判断训练预算与学生是否保留目标推理能力，再评审昇腾部署成本。
row.boundary_en: Ineligible if retraining or model replacement is forbidden. This is one representative source, not a complete distillation genealogy.
row.boundary_zh: 禁止重训或要求保持原模型的专项场景不适用；当前单代表来源，不声称完整蒸馏谱系。
row.name_en: Student distillation: objective and deployed model
row.name_zh: 学生蒸馏：优化目标与部署对象
row.question_en: How can teacher behavior be transferred to a smaller deployed student?
row.question_zh: 如何把教师行为转移给部署时更小的学生？
row.summary_en: MiniLLM defines a smaller-student route using reverse KL and on-policy optimization, rather than a training-free transform of frozen deployed weights.
row.summary_zh: MiniLLM 用反向 KL 与在策略优化形成小模型蒸馏路线；它压缩的是最终部署模型规模，不能被视为对当前冻结权重的无训练变换。

row.ascend_en: First check whether the Ascend runtime consumes the sparsity pattern; dense execution does not establish inference acceleration.
row.ascend_zh: 优先检查昇腾运行栈是否真正消费对应稀疏模式；若仍执行稠密矩阵核，只能讨论权重稀疏性，不能宣称推理加速。
row.boundary_en: Pruning and sparsity are labels of one result, not additive savings; task quality remains a required consideration.
row.boundary_zh: 剪枝和稀疏是同一结果的多标签，不能重复计量；任务质量是不可省略的判断条件。
row.name_en: Weight pruning: reconstruction compensation and activation scoring
row.name_zh: 权重剪枝：重建误差补偿与激活评分
row.question_en: Which weights can be removed, and how are reconstruction error and formats handled?
row.question_zh: 移除哪些权重，如何处理重建误差与执行格式？
row.summary_en: SparseGPT reconstructs locally after pruning; Wanda scores weights with activation statistics without updates. They offer different preparation and quality trade-offs.
row.summary_zh: SparseGPT 对剪枝误差进行局部重建补偿；Wanda 用权重幅值与激活统计直接评分，避免权重更新。二者是不同成本与质量取舍的剪枝路线。

row.ascend_en: Prioritize weight residency and bandwidth, then filter by Ascend formats and kernels. Rotation and codebooks add engineering work; no Ascend gains are established.
row.ascend_zh: 先看权重驻留及访存压力，再按昇腾支持的低位格式、打包方式与执行核筛选。旋转或码本路线有额外工程成本，当前没有昇腾收益结论。
row.boundary_en: For projects forbidding quantization, retain as background knowledge only; joint schemes must not add gains across object tags.
row.boundary_zh: 整体禁用量化的专项项目只保留为领域知识；联合量化不能按对象标签累加收益。
row.name_en: Weight quantization: error compensation, salient channels and rotation
row.name_zh: 权重量化：误差补偿、重要通道与旋转预处理
row.question_en: How can quantization error be controlled in low-bit weights?
row.question_zh: 如何在低位权重表示下控制量化误差？
row.summary_en: Alternative routes use second-order compensation, activation-aware scaling and rotation. QuIP# explicitly extends QuIP; chronology alone implies no inheritance.
row.summary_zh: 同一目标下形成不同路线：GPTQ 用二阶误差补偿，AWQ 用激活感知缩放；QuIP 到 QuIP# 是明确扩展，随后有联合量化旋转研究。时间先后不代表算法继承。

row.ascend_en: For image/video services, review visual-token share, prefill cost, dynamic shapes and gather/merge kernels; Ascend support is not established.
row.ascend_zh: 对图文/视频服务可先分析视觉 token 占比与 prefill 负担，再看动态 token 形状和 gather/merge 算子；不直接声称已支持昇腾。
row.boundary_en: This multimodal branch differs from ordinary text-KV eviction. Encoder, retention budget and training-free/fine-tuned settings must be checked separately.
row.boundary_zh: 属于多模态推理压缩支线，并非普通文本 KV 驱逐。两者免训练/微调条件、编码器与保留预算需分开核对。
row.name_en: Visual tokens: redundancy and text relevance
row.name_zh: 视觉 token 从空间冗余到文本相关性筛选
row.question_en: Where should visual information be reduced while retaining task relevance?
row.question_zh: 图像信息在哪里压缩，如何保持任务相关内容？
row.summary_en: PruMerge selects/merges tokens at the vision-encoder boundary, while SparseVLM uses textual relevance for layer-wise visual pruning and recycling.
row.summary_zh: PruMerge 在视觉编码端按重要性保留与合并，SparseVLM 用文本相关性在语言模型层内选择并回收视觉 token；压缩位置与评分信号不同。
